ABGH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Senior Resident post at ABGH?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident post at Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt Hospital is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident post at Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Senior Resident post is a Post Graduate Degree (MD/DNB/DIPLOMA or equivalent in the concerned stream).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident position is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Senior Resident recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Senior Resident position at ABGH?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the specified venue with all required documents on the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident role at Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt Hospital will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt Hospital located?
faq.answer: Acharyashree Bhikshu Govt Hospital is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110015.
